This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] found within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were distinguished by their elongated faces and wide, ribbed chins. One member of this species was present at [[Grappa (Hutt)|Grappa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]'s [[Grappa's palace|palace]]<ref name="Crimson Empire" /> in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="SWTCC">''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]''</ref>

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ImperialAdvisor2-NRJ-TaoRotJ.jpg|right|150px|thumb|Imperial Advisor concept art by Nilo Rodis-Jamero for ''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]
This species was first designed by [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]] for the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] as a potential design for one of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]]s, though they would go unused,<ref name="Art of">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> later reused for [[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 3|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 3]], illustrated by [[Paul Gulacy]]<ref name="Crimson Empire" /> and published on [[January 13]], [[1999]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54047/star_wars_crimson_empire_ii_-_council_of_blood_1998_3|text=Star Wars: Crimson Empire II - Council of Blood (1998) #3}}</ref>
